[EN] , please return to Velika.

Demokrons have appeared in Arun. Commander Seir requires your presence.
[ES] , por favor regresa a Velika.

Han aparecido Demokrons en Arun. El comandante Seir requiere tu presencia.

[EN] I've come from Velika.
The commander is waiting for you.
[ES] Vengo de Velika.
El comandante te está esperando.

[EN] I'll send you immediately to Velika, when you're ready.
[ES] Te enviaré inmediatamente a Velika cuando estés listo.

[EN] This wasn't easy for the commander.
You should be aware of that Helkan.
[ES] Esto no fue fácil para el comandante.
Deberías estar al tanto de eso, Helkan.
